pages.text: A log stretched across the stream. They played at crossing over it.
Leo strode across. "Easy. I'll show you."
Mei stood before the log. Leo said, "You can't do it."
Mei stepped back. Leo crossed once more.
This time, they crossed slippery rocks. Leo's foot slid.
Splash! Leo fell into the water. His clothes were soaked.
Ppino looked at Leo and repeated his words. "You can't do it."
Grandma Bear gave Leo a towel. "Your words have come back to you."
Mei held out a hand to Leo. "Let's try."
Leo strode across the log, then reached a hand back. "Let's try."
